description: TopBar — the application header. A surface strip (white in light, a raised North Sea panel in dark — canvas sits below surface in both schemes) with a thick subtle underline (the SideBar's right border is the same rule, rotated). Identity leads: a swappable application symbol and the lg application name. Search and ghost-icon action Buttons trail — user settings, notifications, density. No tabs in the top bar: the tutorial showed that pattern, and it is retired.
notes: v0.3.0 (2026-09-04, Victor's design review): underline back to THICK — overrules v0.2.0's hairline (that entry recorded the walk matching CSS down to a hand-built 1px; the design verdict standardises stroke-thick, colour subtle, shared with the SideBar edge). Container rule applied: 16×16 inset (md squared) and gap 16 (spacing-horizontal-md) — the icon-gap token here was the audit catch: icon gaps belong INSIDE atoms, between a glyph and its label. Distribution is now the CONTRACT's fact, not the consumer's: the title fills, search and actions trail to the inline end. Title steps up to lg compressed. The app symbol is an INSTANCE_SWAP slot — teams drop their product mark in; 'apps' is the placeholder — carried in code as consumer markup in the symbol cell. Search detail (same day): the Input instance shows the magnifier (Has Leading Icon on + the magnifier swapped in — the Input's default leading icon is 'add circle outlined', a fields-walk placeholder) and reads 'Search'. v0.4.0 (2026-09-04, same review): two spacing rungs discovered while Victor eyeballed the strip against the ladder. SEAT (xs, raw): a strip seating CONTROLS pads its cross-axis with the seat rung — one relation tighter than cluster; no optical compensation (controls carry no half-leading; icon-only precedent); height emerges as tallest control + 2×seat = 36/52/68 across densities. CLUSTER (sm): the three actions form one group; within-group gap sits one rung below the container gap (Gestalt + the optical argument: buttons bring their own air). Ladder purity chosen over the half-gap derivation (which resurrects EDS 1.x's 64 at relaxed but mints an off-ladder 10). v0.5.0 (2026-09-05, after the sidebar's slots): the three hard-coded actions became a TRUE SLOT that IS the actions cluster (sm gap bound on the slot itself) — designers add as many ghost-icon Buttons as they want (Victor's open-ended requirement, SCOPE polish item CLOSED); the account/notifications/tune trio remains as seed content. CSS unchanged: the .eds-actions cluster wrapper already was consumer markup. v0.6.0 (2026-09-05): the search field gets an authored width — 256, the rail's number (a deliberate rhyme).
